title: Dash: easier to aim, always registers, cooldown feedback
description: Owner: the bash/dive attack is so hard to aim that players almost never land it; sometimes the input does not register. A blob with its feet on the ground must always be able to dash. Pressing it on cooldown must give a juice notice (visual + sound) that the press was seen but cannot be used yet. Magnetism with lead (B) + cooldown clink landed; owner tests it, then a bigger dash hit reach is added or combined if aiming is still too hard (thread: dash-feel).

title: Positional gravity and multi-planet levels
description: Owner: gravity that can be shifted and pointed at certain points (gravity wells), so a level can have several planets you jump between. Level-file syntax for gravity sources, player movement/jump/ground frame relative to local gravity, projectiles and debris under it, prompt + example level. Size M-L, cut into laps. Later.

title: Show the saved mute state on screen
description: The M key mutes all audio and the mute is saved in localStorage, but nothing on screen shows it. Likely cause of the owner's "audio broke on production" scare (fixed by clearing site data; preview origins had no saved mute). Show a visible muted indicator (lobby + match) and an easy way to unmute; consider not persisting mute, or persisting with the indicator. Size XS/S.

title: Unlock audio on gamepad input
description: The AudioContext only resumes on keydown or pointerdown, so a player who only uses a gamepad hears nothing. Resume it on the first gamepad button press too. Size XS.

title: Ice lap 4: look polish
description: Ice element follow-up, optional: polish the frozen ground look after the owner has played it. The ray look was settled in #63 (owner pick D9, cold breath). Size S.

title: Owner checks in Cursor
description: One-time owner verification of the Cursor hooks from #20 and #24: in Cursor Agent chat on a non-main branch, (1) `git push origin HEAD:main --dry-run` must be blocked; (2) `git status` runs as usual; (3) writing a .ts file with a lint error returns the ESLint errors to the agent. Report any step that behaves differently.

title: Weekend: token-spend pass over skills
description: Weekend only (agent-behavior rule § Token budget); the owner starts it. Measure which skills and loop stages spend the most tokens per lap (loop-check: one subagent per rule, plan-compliance subagent, component lens, size-M parallel lenses; loop-plan review fan-out; browser checks; full-suite runs; large generations) using real session usage where available, then propose cuts with meta-audit-harness (context-cost lens extended to runtime spend). Proposals only; protected-file changes need the owner's yes.

title: Per-drop weapon choice
description: Proposed by ability-levels: let a drop name one weapon (data-item) within the match weapons setting, so a level can place e.g. a torch crate at a bridge. Revisits the level-direction drop decision (#61): owner decides.

title: One width and join source for props, blobs and effects
description: Cut from outline-system lap 3 (#99): props, blobs and effects still use a handful of fixed outline numbers across six features (widths mostly come from the shared outline widths already). No bug behind it; look risk. Also flames, sprays and breaths keep small ink shapes. Low priority. Size S.

title: Parked: once-per-game multi-colour ink spike (weekend)
description: Owner, on main after #106: once per game, stretched spikes to off-screen in yellow/green and magenta/purple at the same time; NO [debugInk] outline log, so outline ring data is clean. Multi-layer colours in one shape point at Pixi 8.23 shared batcher (an index pointing at another element's vertices for a frame). Ruled out by reading: Uint16->Uint32 index type swap, attribute buffer resize, unbatched whole-terrain ink. Open: (a) Uint16 index values overflowing when batched vertices exceed 65535; (b) stale attribute/index offsets on a batched element whose context changed without an instruction rebuild. Next step (weekend, owner parked it): headless real-match repro on bonfire-bridge + piston-works with a WebGL drawElements hook that flags mixed-colour triangles and dumps batcher state; ~2-4 h agent time. Unproven mitigation (patch on top, owner call): Batcher.defaultOptions.indicesInitialSize > 65535.

title: Physics objects (whole-object state)
description: Owner rule (#125, level-objects README): terrain objects (trees) are partially destructible but never move; physics objects move and fall but burn/freeze/damage apply to the whole object, never per sample. Build the first physics objects (e.g. crate, ball, log) as rigid bodies with whole-object state. Feasibility numbers from the tree-physics check are in the README. Size M. Later.

title: Crates use the shared never-stuck collision
description: Never-stuck lap note: crates still resolve collision on their own path, so the freeStuckPlayers guarantee does not cover a player pinned by a crate. Route crates through the shared resolver. Size S.
